textbox.config.title: Configure area textbox
textbox.config.name: Name
textbox.config.tooltip.name: Name shown in the dialog. Empty = your real name.
textbox.config.tooltip.icon: Item (minecraft:...), @player or image URL. Empty = your head.
textbox.config.tooltip.box_texture: Image URL for the box (64x64, 9-slice). Empty = default box.
textbox.config.tooltip.position: Top (below the bossbar) or bottom (above the health bar).
textbox.config.tooltip.blocking: Yes = full screen. No = text over the world.
textbox.config.tooltip.radius: Radius in blocks where your textbox is visible (4-24).
textbox.config.tooltip.time: Seconds the text takes to type out.
textbox.config.tooltip.area: Show your chat messages as a textbox.
textbox.gui.no_permission: You need admin permission to access this interface.
textbox.command.area_chat.enabled: Area chat enabled: your messages will be shown as textboxes.
textbox.command.player_only: This command can only be run by a player.
